description: This file contains unit tests for the EventBusAuthenticationService class, verifying its behavior in handling authentication requests over Vert.x event bus, including success and failure scenarios.

classes.name: EventBusAuthenticationServiceTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for EventBusAuthenticationService, testing authentication logic over Vert.x event bus.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes Vert.x instance and configures token helpers before all tests.

methods.name: unregisterAuthRequestConsumer
methods.description: Cleans up the event bus consumer after each test.

methods.name: testAuthenticateSuccess
methods.description: Tests successful authentication flow when a valid token is received via event bus.

methods.name: testAuthenticateFailureNoHandler
methods.description: Tests failure when no handler is registered to respond to authentication requests.

methods.name: testAuthenticateFailureValidStatusCode
methods.description: Tests failure response when the event bus reply fails with HTTP unauthorized status.

methods.name: testAuthenticateFailureInvalidStatusCode
methods.description: Tests internal error handling when an invalid failure code is received.

methods.name: createTestToken
methods.description: Creates a sample test token for authentication tests.
